scope: Read-only source audit and in-memory syntax/derivation checks; no duplicate native, supplier, or release replay. Pending CLAIM/MANIFEST/SOURCES was expected draft state.

checks.fresh_default: Two changed natives plus two retained natives plus retained parent; retained reuse requires explicit flag.
checks.paths: Scripts resolve package/repository from __file__, child paths use argv lists, working trees are fresh and source-separated; no author-machine absolute path found.
checks.strict_gain: Reproducer uses Fraction and exact equality of incumbent kappa and kappa_rational, then candidate > incumbent.
checks.changed_inputs: Full source/cache inventories and package/external hashes rechecked after admission.

findings.issue: Whole-chain LF adapter missing. prepare_native.py installs sitecustomize only in its own subprocess env; reproduce.py starts complete-admission from its original env. On Windows admission LF preflight deterministically rejects after native preparation.
findings.evidence: admit_integer_prefix.py creates .lf-preflight.txt using Path.write_text without newline and requires exact LF bytes; predecessor portable_frontier_cold.py installs LF_ADAPTER and PYTHONPATH for the whole subprocess chain.
findings.fix: Install an authenticated process-scoped LF adapter in reproduce work and pass it to all child stages, including prepared-native reuse.

findings.issue: No semantic recheck of retained parent STAGES or the retained native pair on the prepared-native entry path. Current bytes are bound, but the comment that the admission driver validates all16 stages is false: it reads parent RESULT and receipt hashes, not the stage list. A rebound receipt can omit/fail a parent stage while retaining its PASS RESULT.
findings.evidence: reuse_retained() explicitly requires receipt.files exactly RESULT.json/STAGES.json, 16 successful stages, expected word hashes, and both five-stage retained native bindings. authenticate_native() checks current providers only; admit_integer_prefix.py checks parent RESULT and per-file digests but not stage coverage.
findings.fix: Repeat the retained native/word/parent receipt and all16 semantic stage predicates in authenticate_native(), using the unchanged utility policy.

fix_validation.scope: No complete native, supplier, or release replay; actual complete prepared-native authentication plus hash-rebound corruption controls on a temporary copy, and two trivial LF subprocesses.
